about: Pinned ReXGlue SDK binaries (our own data, no game content). tools\build.ps1 refuses to build/stage when a rex*.dll it would stage, or one already staged next to the exe, is not listed here (name + sha256). Add entries with: pwsh -File tools\build_sdk.ps1 -Run NAME -Pin "note". rexglue.exe (codegen) is listed for traceability; build.ps1 only reports it. Newest entry last.
